name: usage-list-status
goal: Show clean Used In and Uses lists while retaining the verification mark on each entity page.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Remove verification marks from Used In and Uses rows. Preserve names, role/change badges, descriptions and revision-aware links; keep the entity header mark.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing usage tests check sections and destinations, but not status placement. Strengthen their shared browser assertions and SSR coverage to reject row marks while retaining the header mark.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Red 685c4ee7 at 2149299b fails the no-row-marks assertion at desktop, tablet and mobile widths. The failing test commit precedes the product repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Both shared renderers omit per-row status components. Links, purpose text and kind/change/plan badges remain; entity header status stays available.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Green f410dd83 at 5da392e0 passes the unchanged usage browser cases at three widths and both renderer unit suites. Red 685c4ee7 uses the same 1,257 frozen inputs and environment.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
